Following recent success of bringing clan wars back on the menu, {{player|Link|flag=no}} takes no break in launching another season - just weeks after [[Qlan_War_Tournament_1|Qlan War 1]] concluded seeing {{player|Commando|flag=eu|link=false}} raising their spears at the throne. 

The sibling tourney [[Qenya War Tournament 1]] also spawned off [[Qlan_War_Tournament_1|Qlan War 1]], with a wider map pool, running in parallel to this.
